title: Sr UI / UX Designer
description:
Design and develop high-quality, visually appealing, and interactive user interfaces. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify design requirements and solutions. Develop and maintain design guidelines, standards, and best practices. Conduct user research and testing to inform design decisions. Create prototypes and high-fidelity designs to communicate design concepts. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in UI/UX design.
